steps.title: Filter icon — Offline option
steps.notes: Live-confirmed real behavior (filter panel shows an 'Offline (N)' checkbox option; the same tap target opens and closes it), but not currently automatable: the funnel icon has no content-desc/text of its own — it's merged into its parent row's accessibility node, whose merged bounds-center overlaps the 'Stopped' chip rather than the icon itself. run_plan.py's tap action only supports text-selector resolution, no coordinate fallback, so action is intentionally null pending a coordinate-tap capability addition to the shared script.
